items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: Kid Howard, yeah, he was plenty powerful.

ctx.x: Kid Howard, yeah, he was plenty powerful. Well, Rene was living, because I think after they left the Astuart, the Beansy hired Rene Band. After Lee's band. Yeah, after we left there, he hired Rene Band. I just remember who was in that band, because I was on the boat when I was out of town. I don't remember just exactly who was in it. But I think I'm most sure he had his brother on drum. I don't know whether Zeb was living and that, I don't remember yet.
Who was the best drummer going around in those days? Can you remember that?
